transcript_tail.text: Memory added and indexed; the stale "not yet merged" line in the related memory is fixed too. On "or add a skill" — the `rename-sessions` skill already exists and documents this exact command (incl. `--only`), so a duplicate isn't worth it. Let me check whether it's actually linked into `~/.claude/skills` (per the vendored-skills convention it needs `link.sh` + a fresh session to become invocable as `/rename-sessions`).

Done. Here's where both options landed:

**Memory — added** (`project_retitle_sessions.md`):
> Retitle ai-harness sessions → `python3 -m remote_control titles apply --only ai-harness` (drop `--only` for all repos); idempotent, dry-run with `list`.

Indexed in `MEMORY.md`, linked to `[[project-code-sessions-no-groups]]` + `[[project-skills-vendored]]`, and I corrected the related memory's now-stale "not yet merged" note (it's merged + live).

**Skill — already exists, no new one needed.** `skills/rename-sessions/SKILL.md` covers this exact command (including `--only <repo>`), and it's **already symlinked** into `~/.claude/skills/rename-sessions`. So `/rename-sessions` is invocable — just not in *this* session (the skill list is fixed at session start; it'll show up in a fresh session). Adding a second ai-harness-specific skill would only duplicate it.

So: the recall is captured for me (memory) and the `/`-shortcut already exists for you (skill). Nothing more to add unless you want a different name/alias for the skill.
Let me verify what's actually live on the server right now (fresh fetch), because that determines whether this is a "didn't save" problem or a "Claude app is showing stale/cached titles" problem.

Good news: the rename **100% worked server-side** — I just re-fetched live and every title has its prefix:

```
cse_01K123…  '[AH] Land titles tool: commit, merge, push'   ← this session
cse_01KAWg…  '[FF] Start work session'
cse_01T5q3…  '[JOB] Resume'
cse_019ZC9…  '[FF] Security: merge codex-security-scan-infra-plan to main (#14)'
…  (100 sessions returned, all prefixed)
```

So this isn't a "didn't save" problem — it's a **"which Claude surface are you looking at + cache"** problem. Two things to know:

1. **These are cloud `/v1/code/sessions`.** They show in the **Claude desktop/mobile app → Code** and **claude.ai/code (web)**. Those clients cache the session list — if it was open before the rename, you need to **refresh/reload** (reopen the app, or pull-to-refresh / ⌘R the web page) to re-fetch.

2. **The terminal `claude` resume picker does NOT use these titles** — it reads local `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` files. So if you're looking at the CLI's session list, it will *never* show the `[AH]`/`[FF]` prefixes no matter what the API says — different data source entirely.

To give you the exact fix, where are you looking?
